title: AGS Policy Rule
description: A single deterministic, deny-by-default policy rule evaluated at the tool boundary before any action runs. Formalizes AGS principle #1 (deterministic policy as code, not prompt-level safety). The policy is a list of these; the first matching allow grants, otherwise the action is denied.

agent.description: Agent id this rule applies to, or '*' for any.

action.description: Action name this rule applies to, or '*' for any.

resource.description: Resource this rule applies to, or '*' for any.

ring_max.description: Highest privilege ring the rule grants to (principle #5, privilege rings).
